task: Compare effects-query uncertainty for an untyped object-method receiver.
observation: For fn invoke(box): result = box.risky(1), C++ reported box type null and the function effect summary conservative_unresolved; Java had fabricated type int and certainty resolved. Java query serialization now preserves unknown parameter types and marks object-method receiver effects unresolved when receiver nominal type is unavailable. SemanticQueryEngineTest passes, and minimized C++/Java outputs agree on type, unresolved and certainty fields.
impact: Before this correction, semantic queries presented an unresolved generic receiver effect as a resolved empty summary and exposed a false parameter type. Other effect dimensions and query schema differences remain.
evidence: tmp/phase25-3-margo-smoke/generic_method_effects_cpp.json and generic_method_effects_java_after.json agree on ownership type null, unresolved true, and conservative_unresolved

resolution.summary: Unknown function parameter types are no longer fabricated as Int in effects ownership rows, and unresolved generic method receivers mark effect certainty conservative.

task: Validate deterministic source-location and call-graph query candidates.
observation: The existing check_semantic_queries.py failed because one source call appeared three times in Java line-resolution candidates. A second same-target call on one line showed six Java call-query edges where C++ retained two. Repeated type-check inference had accumulated duplicate internal call edges. Java query projections now cap same-source/target/line edges to syntactic call occurrences on that source line, excluding comments and quoted text. Genuine repeated calls remain separate. SemanticQueryEngineTest and the Phase 22.3 semantic-query tool check pass.
impact: Duplicate call candidates made location resolution nondeterministic in content and overstated direct-call graph edges. The correction is scoped to query projection and does not claim the internal semantic edge store is deduplicated.
evidence: tmp/phase25-3-margo-smoke/resolve_44_cpp.json and resolve_44_java.json show prior duplicate candidates
tmp/phase25-3-margo-smoke/twice_call_cpp.json and twice_call_java.json show prior 2-versus-6 direct edges

resolution.summary: Source-location and call-graph query outputs now limit repeated inference edges to observed syntactic call occurrences on the line.
